MathJax 3.2.2 (mathjax-full)
https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src
Copyright (c) 2009-2022 The MathJax Consortium
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see mathjax-LICENSE.txt).

The application bundles MathJax's MathML input, SVG output and default TeX glyph
data in its lazy math image module. Application adapters sanitize the input and
rebuild the generated SVG before exporting PNG. No MathJax code is modified.
